title: Towards Agentic Self-Learning LLMs in Search Environment
problem: Open-domain search agents lack scalable tasks and reliable automatically verifiable rewards.
assumption_broken: Task generation and reward verification need not remain fixed while a policy learns.
operational_signature: Generate → solve → judge → jointly update
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-training a shared-backbone task generator, solver, and generative reward model maintains informative supervision as task difficulty increases.

improver_modified.how: The task generator and generative reward model are themselves updated through reinforcement learning each cycle.

limitations_evident: Only text-based search agents are evaluated.
Verification capacity eventually limits continued improvement.
Late-stage gains can require real verification data.

title: DRO-InstructZero: Distributionally Robust Prompt Optimization for Large Language Models
problem: Average-case prompt optimization yields brittle instructions under distribution shift.
assumption_broken: The evaluation distribution need not be fixed and representative of deployment.
operational_signature: Propose → evaluate → reweight → acquire
load_bearing_mechanism: A distributionally robust Bayesian acquisition maximizes worst-case utility over an ambiguity set rather than nominal average accuracy.
limitations_evident: Adversarial reweighting adds computation.
Divergence and radius are fixed.
Reported task counts and divergence formulations are inconsistent.

title: EvolveR: Self-Evolving LLM Agents through an Experience-Driven Lifecycle
problem: Agents forget interaction outcomes and cannot systematically refine reusable problem-solving strategies.
assumption_broken: Experience need not remain raw retrieved cases or transient reflections disconnected from policy learning.
operational_signature: Interact → distill → curate → retrieve → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-distilled strategic principles are deduplicated and utility-scored, retrieved during interaction, and integrated with reinforcement learning.

improver_modified.how: The policy that distills principles is itself updated through GRPO between experience-distillation phases.

limitations_evident: Small models have limited self-distillation ability.
Experiments concentrate on question answering.
Training requires reinforcement learning and experience-base maintenance.

title: RGMem: Renormalization Group-inspired Memory Evolution for Language Agents
problem: Flat fact-level memories cannot preserve stable user traits while adapting to conflicting cross-session evidence.
assumption_broken: All conversational memories need not evolve at the same abstraction scale or update rate.
operational_signature: Extract → aggregate → threshold → abstract → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical coarse-graining and evidence-thresholded updates separate fast-changing facts from slowly evolving user traits.
limitations_evident: Only two conversational memory benchmarks are evaluated.
Update thresholds require calibration.
Renormalization is an engineering analogy rather than an explicitly optimized physical objective.

title: DelvePO: Direction-Guided Self-Evolving Framework for Flexible Prompt Optimization
problem: Random whole-prompt rewriting loses useful components and converges prematurely.
assumption_broken: Prompt mutation need not be directionless or operate on an indivisible instruction.
operational_signature: Decompose → recall → mutate → recombine → rank
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level and whole-prompt memories guide which prompt components evolve and how their values are mutated or crossed.

improver_modified.how: Performance-ranked component and prompt memories are updated to guide subsequent evolutionary operations.

limitations_evident: Memory context increases token costs.
Promptbreeder and ablations use only one seed.
Component values and model coverage are resource-limited.

title: Search Self-play: Pushing the Frontier of Agent Capability without Supervision
problem: Agentic reinforcement learning is constrained by scarce verified questions and static synthetic task difficulty.
assumption_broken: Search training tasks need not be supplied by humans or a frozen offline synthesizer.
operational_signature: Search → propose → verify → challenge → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: RAG verification filters unanswerable proposals while adversarial proposer-solver co-training continually raises task difficulty.

improver_modified.how: The question proposer is updated with REINFORCE while the solver is updated with GRPO.

limitations_evident: Evaluations use small benchmark subsamples.
Correctness depends on an LLM judge and RAG verification.
Experiments use a fixed Wikipedia retrieval environment.

title: LightMem: Lightweight and Efficient Memory-Augmented Generation
problem: Persistent agent memories impose excessive token, API-call, and online maintenance overhead.
assumption_broken: Memory consolidation need not process every turn independently or occur synchronously during inference.
operational_signature: Compress → segment → summarize → insert → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Topic-aware compressed buffering reduces construction calls while sleep-time parallel updates decouple expensive consolidation from online inference.
limitations_evident: Compression and buffer thresholds trade accuracy against cost.
Stored dialogue introduces privacy and misinformation risks.
Evaluation centers on text conversation memory.

title: How to Auto-optimize Prompts for Domain Tasks? Adaptive Prompting and Reasoning through Evolutionary Domain Knowledge Adaptation
problem: Imperfect expert knowledge and poorly integrated reasoning guidance limit domain-specific LLM predictions.
assumption_broken: Expert semantic causal graphs need not be complete, correct, or fixed during prompt optimization.
operational_signature: Ground → predict → critique → alternate edits → accept
load_bearing_mechanism: Ground-truth textual gradients alternately refine semantic causal graphs and reasoning prompts, accepting only individual improvements.
limitations_evident: Best of three API runs is reported rather than variance.
Validation and test sets contain only 100 instances each.
Additional textual-gradient computation and API instability remain.

title: Huxley-Gödel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
problem: Immediate coding benchmark performance poorly predicts which self-modifying agents will generate productive descendants.
assumption_broken: The highest-performing current agent need not be the best parent for further self-improvement.
operational_signature: Estimate descendants → sample parent → self-edit → evaluate → archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Clade-level metaproductivity estimates guide Thompson-sampling expansion while adaptive scheduling separates evaluation from modification.

improver_modified.how: Archived coding agents modify their own codebases and can change their subsequent self-modification capabilities.

limitations_evident: The theoretical oracle result relies on restricted cost and repeatability assumptions.
Optimization on benchmark tasks can overfit.
A baseline terminates early because of context-window failures.

title: Multi-Agent Evolve: LLM Self-Improve through Co-evolution
problem: General-domain self-play lacks reliable training feedback without labels or executable verifiers.
assumption_broken: Self-play learning need not be restricted to environments with externally verifiable rewards.
operational_signature: Propose → filter → solve → judge → synchronize updates
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared-backbone proposer-solver-judge triad combines adversarial difficulty rewards, quality filtering, and synchronized reinforcement learning.

improver_modified.how: Shared-backbone updates change the proposer and judge along with the solver; the judge receives format rewards.

limitations_evident: Only Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is evaluated.
Judge correctness is not externally grounded during learning.
Question diversity and dataset corruption can destabilize training.

title: Alita-G: Self-Evolving Generative Agent for Agent Generation
problem: Generalist agents repeatedly reconstruct domain-specific sub-solutions instead of reusing specialized tools.
assumption_broken: Agent adaptation need not be confined to prompt rewriting or retries; generated executable tools can persist across tasks.
operational_signature: Execute → harvest successes → parameterize → index → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful task trajectories yield abstracted MCP primitives whose descriptions and use cases support focused retrieval at inference.
limitations_evident: GAIA validation tasks are used for both tool harvesting and evaluation.
PathVQA and HLE evaluations use 100 examples each.
Reported inference savings exclude full tool-generation costs.

title: SPICE: Self-Play In Corpus Environments Improves Reasoning
problem: Ungrounded self-play plateaus through hallucination amplification and identical proposer-solver knowledge.
assumption_broken: Self-play task generation need not rely only on knowledge internalized by the solver.
operational_signature: Sample documents → generate → hide context → solve → co-train
load_bearing_mechanism: Corpus-grounded information asymmetry and variance-based challenger rewards create a renewable frontier-difficulty curriculum.

improver_modified.how: The challenger and reasoner share weights jointly updated with role-specific DrGRPO advantages.

limitations_evident: Document grounding does not independently prove generated question correctness.
Benefits depend on corpus content and diversity.
Training-run variance is not reported in the provided text.

title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
problem: Real-environment rollouts are expensive, sparse, and difficult to scale for agent reinforcement learning.
assumption_broken: Effective agent training need not require perfectly realistic or directly executed environment transitions.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → simulate transitions → train → generate challenges → replenish
load_bearing_mechanism: A reasoning-based textual experience model grounded in replay trajectories synthesizes rollouts and entropy-targeted task curricula.

improver_modified.how: The replay buffer conditioning the experience model is continuously enriched with new synthetic interactions.

limitations_evident: Primarily single-environment training.
Transfer to substantially different embodied domains degrades.
Synthetic dynamics depend on limited offline real trajectories.

title: Self-Abstraction from Grounded Experience for Plan-Guided Policy Refinement
problem: Static software agents fail to turn long, noisy first-attempt trajectories into effective subsequent repair strategies.
assumption_broken: A coding agent need not solve a task from scratch in one rollout or reuse the entire raw trajectory.
operational_signature: Explore → abstract plan → reset → execute with guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: A concise plan induced from grounded execution captures dependencies and constraints for a second attempt without external verifier feedback.
limitations_evident: Plans are reused on the same issue rather than demonstrated across tasks.
Evaluation is restricted to SWE-bench Verified.
Self-assessment bias reduces plan quality relative to some cross-model planners.

title: FLEX: Continuous Agent Evolution via Forward Learning from Experience
problem: Frozen agents cannot accumulate scalable, transferable learning from deployment experiences without costly parameter updates.
assumption_broken: Learning need not modify weights or remain tied to the model that generated the experience.
operational_signature: Explore → reflect → update library → retrieve → reason
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent semantic experience library distills successes and failures into reusable guidance that can be inherited across models.
limitations_evident: Scientific task evaluations often use small training or test subsets.
Library growth increases stored experience and retrieval demands.
Scaling evidence is concentrated on GSM8k.

title: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
problem: Static reasoning datasets saturate and waste reinforcement-learning rollouts on problems that are too easy or hard.
assumption_broken: Procedural environment difficulty need not remain fixed throughout policy training.
operational_signature: Sample difficulty → generate → verify → train → raise frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Per-environment sliding difficulty windows advance when frontier accuracy crosses a threshold, maintaining informative reward variation.
limitations_evident: All 400 environments require substantial manual engineering.
Non-verifiable open-ended domains are not addressed.
Difficulty control depends on environment-specific parameters.

title: From Experience to Strategy: Empowering LLM Agents with Trainable Graph Memory
problem: Static explicit memory cannot adaptively prioritize useful experience or effectively guide policy learning.
assumption_broken: Human-readable strategic memory need not remain untrained or be used only at inference.
operational_signature: Abstract paths → induce strategies → compare rewards → reweight graph → guide learning
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE updates graph edges using the reward difference between strategy-guided and unguided trajectories, prioritizing causally useful guidance.

improver_modified.how: Learned graph weights change the strategy-retrieval mechanism used to guide subsequent policy training.

limitations_evident: Utility estimation requires paired guided and unguided rollouts.
Too many retrieved strategies introduce noise.
Empirical validation concentrates on QA.

title: AgentEvolver: Towards Efficient Self-Evolving Agent System
problem: Manual task construction, random exploration, and sparse credit assignment make agent reinforcement learning costly.
assumption_broken: Task synthesis, exploration guidance, and step-level learning signals need not be rigid human-engineered inputs.
operational_signature: Explore → synthesize tasks → retrieve guidance → attribute contributions → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-questioning, experience-mixed rollouts, and LLM-based action attribution jointly improve task coverage and sample utilization.

improver_modified.how: An evolving experience pool supplies reusable guidance for subsequent exploration and policy learning.

limitations_evident: Validation is limited to AppWorld and BFCL multi-turn tasks.
Several stronger external models perform synthesis and attribution.
Environment profiles and user preferences are manually specified.

title: WebCoach: Self-Evolving Web Agents with Cross-Session Memory Guidance
problem: Web agents repeat navigation errors across sessions because they cannot retain and consult prior experience.
assumption_broken: Improving deployed web agents need not require retraining or altering their internal workflow.
operational_signature: Condense → store episodes → retrieve analogues → selectively advise → accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: A runtime coach injects concise advice from relevant completed episodes only when intervention appears useful.
limitations_evident: Coaching increases average runtime despite reducing actions.
Performance gains depend on actor model scale.
Live websites introduce changing evaluation conditions.

title: Live-SWE-agent: Can Software Engineering Agents Self-Evolve on the Fly?
problem: Fixed coding-agent toolsets are costly to design and cannot adapt to issue-specific needs at runtime.
assumption_broken: Agent tooling need not be pre-engineered or evolved offline before solving an issue.
operational_signature: Act → inspect feedback → synthesize tool → execute → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A step-reflection reminder makes custom executable tool creation an ongoing decision interleaved with issue solving.
limitations_evident: Tools are generated per issue rather than shown to accumulate across tasks.
Several comparisons reuse published results with differing backbones.
Implemented evolution focuses on tool scripts rather than changing the core loop.

title: AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization
problem: Emerging accelerators lack established kernel optimization expertise and require costly design-space exploration.
assumption_broken: Kernel optimization heuristics need not be supplied by hardware experts before search begins.
operational_signature: Plan → rewrite → profile → retain fast candidates → distill memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Beam search is guided by a bounded memory of distilled slow-fast kernel transformations, including reversed failed optimizations.

improver_modified.how: Optimization memory is curated from measured transformations and changes the planner guidance in later iterations.

limitations_evident: Memory is per kernel; cross-kernel transfer is left to future work.
NKIBench contains only 14 kernels.
Timing excludes compilation and proprietary reasoning-token costs are unavailable.

title: Agent0: Unleashing Self-Evolving Agents from Zero Data via Tool-Integrated Reasoning
problem: Data-free self-evolution stagnates when model-only tasks fail to challenge multi-step tool reasoning.
assumption_broken: A self-generated curriculum need not remain limited to single-turn, tool-free reasoning.
operational_signature: Generate frontier tasks → measure uncertainty → filter → solve with tools → alternate training
load_bearing_mechanism: Tool-use and uncertainty rewards co-evolve curriculum difficulty while ambiguity-aware policy updates reduce noisy majority-label reinforcement.

improver_modified.how: The curriculum agent is reinforcement-trained between executor learning stages.

limitations_evident: Majority-vote pseudo-labels can reinforce shared errors.
Experiments use only two Qwen3 base sizes.
Tool-use rewards are proxies rather than direct guarantees of useful complexity.

title: General Agentic Memory Via Deep Research
problem: Ahead-of-time memory compression loses fine-grained historical details needed by unforeseen requests.
assumption_broken: Memory need not precompute a complete answer-ready representation before the query arrives.
operational_signature: Preserve pages → index highlights → plan search → integrate → reflect
load_bearing_mechanism: A lightweight memorizer preserves full history while a researcher constructs query-specific context through iterative search and reflection.
limitations_evident: Researcher quality degrades with backbones of 7B or smaller.
Additional search and reflection increase test-time computation.
Reinforcement optimization is formulated but not empirically demonstrated in the provided experiments.

title: AutoEnv: Automated Environments for Measuring Cross-Environment Agent Learning
problem: Fixed agent-learning methods lose effectiveness as environment rules become more heterogeneous.
assumption_broken: The learning method itself need not remain fixed across environments.
operational_signature: Generate worlds → collect trajectories → edit components → select candidates → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: A component-centric selection, optimization, and evaluation formulation exposes environment-specific learning-method combinations for comparison.
limitations_evident: Only 36 text-focused environments are evaluated.
Environment reliability checks are imperfect.
Per-environment best-method upper bounds are not a deployable general controller.

title: DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for Deep Research
problem: Static reward criteria inadequately supervise knowledge-intensive long-form research and invite reward hacking.
assumption_broken: Evaluation rubrics can evolve with the policy rather than remaining fixed throughout training.
operational_signature: Sample responses → contrast evidence → update rubrics → score → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Search-grounded positive and negative rubrics co-evolve with responses and are retained according to their reward-discriminating variance.

improver_modified.how: The active reward-rubric buffer is regenerated and filtered using current policy rollouts.

limitations_evident: Rubric generation and judging depend on proprietary models.
Training consumes 27000 H100 GPU hours beyond supervised fine-tuning.
Clinical evaluation contains only 47 questions.

title: Guided Self-Evolving LLMs with Minimal Human Supervision
problem: Ungrounded self-play suffers concept drift, diversity collapse, and unstable reasoning gains.
assumption_broken: Self-evolution need not exclude small amounts of human-labeled grounding data.
operational_signature: Sample anchors → generate challenges → rank uncertainty → mix training → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Few-shot human anchors stabilize challenger generation while a mid-difficulty curriculum mixes human and synthetic solver training.

improver_modified.how: The challenger is updated by GRPO as the solver and its difficulty estimates evolve.

limitations_evident: Depends on a curated human anchor pool.
Some baseline results are taken from other reports.
Open-ended domains without objective correctness remain future work.

title: Evolving Excellence: Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents
problem: Interacting prompts, tool descriptions, and parameters make manual agent configuration tuning expensive and brittle.
assumption_broken: Agent configuration components need not be optimized independently or through architecture-specific integrations.
operational_signature: Discover components → mutate configurations → filter cheaply → benchmark → recombine
load_bearing_mechanism: Semantic genetic operators and global combination search jointly optimize heterogeneous agent configurations using execution feedback.
limitations_evident: Competitive-programming gains are not statistically significant.
Prompt optimization takes 411.2 hours in one setting.
Cross-project performance varies and generalization remains uncertain.

title: Confucius Code Agent: Scalable Agent Scaffolding for Real-World Codebases
problem: Coding agents struggle with long-horizon repository reasoning and repeated failures under brittle scaffolds.
assumption_broken: Tool-use conventions and scaffold configurations can be refined automatically rather than exclusively hand-engineered.
operational_signature: Build scaffold → execute tasks → inspect failures → refine tools → retain notes
load_bearing_mechanism: A meta-agent uses a build-test-improve cycle to refine actionable tool-use behavior within a modular memory-aware scaffold.
limitations_evident: Memory evaluation repeats exactly the same 151 tasks.
Context ablation includes only cases where both variants produced executable solutions.
Meta-agent optimization cost and selection split are not established in the excerpt.

title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
problem: Append-only procedural memories accumulate irrelevant or harmful experiences and fail to adapt to changing tasks.
assumption_broken: Stored experience must be adapted and pruned rather than passively accumulated.
operational_signature: Contrast trajectories → distill experiences → adapt retrieval → track utility → prune
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained procedural experiences are selectively added after success and deleted when repeated retrieval has low observed utility.
limitations_evident: Experiences are retrieved only once at task start.
LLM-based validation can miss nuanced quality problems.
Dynamic evaluation updates memory using preceding task outcomes.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library
problem: Prompt-only skill-library agents inconsistently generate useful reusable skills and exploit them on later tasks.
assumption_broken: Skill generation can be trained using rewards from subsequent tasks rather than isolated task outcomes.
operational_signature: Chain tasks → generate skills → reuse skills → reward downstream success → update policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Sequential rollouts retain skills across related tasks and assign skill-integrated rewards to generation and successful reuse.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the policy that generates, repairs, saves, and uses reusable skills.

limitations_evident: Evaluation is confined to AppWorld.
Default retrieval uses privileged scenario labels.
Training chains contain only two tasks and rely on expert-generated supervised warm-up.
